bio: Lost Desert is an electronic music producer who has built a decades-long career in deep, atmospheric house, working primarily from a home studio using field recordings (rain, seed shakers) alongside Logic, Spectrasonics plugins, and a Moog One synthesizer. He is the primary collaborator of Lee Burridge on the All Day I Dream label, co-creating releases including the "Melt" LP, and also runs his own label, Souksonic.
notable_releases: Melt LP (with Lee Burridge, All Day I Dream), Saudade EP, Incipient, Soukmelange Vol 1, Bloesem
labels: All Day I Dream (with Lee Burridge); Souksonic (own label)
notable_collaborations: Lee Burridge (Melt, Eye to Eye, Vutuka and others)

bio: Pomboklap is the stage name of Jorge Juan Pombo Lorenzo, a Spanish DJ/producer born June 18, 1993 in Ponferrada, who comes from a musical family (a saxophonist father and vocalist mother). He started playing vinyl at 14 and moved into house/hip-hop-influenced electronic music by 16, later becoming a resident DJ across Leon's Bierzo region before relocating to Ibiza and then Madrid, where he now works as A&R for Sacro Music and founded Madrid Electronic Music.

Miko Franconi is a DJ/producer based on Oahu, Hawaii, and the younger brother of DJ Keoki. After roughly 4.5 years absorbing the Los Angeles dance music scene, he founded the Centered Hawaii event series in October 2018, starting as a Wednesday weekly in Chinatown before expanding across Honolulu venues including Hawaiian Brian's and the Alohilani Waikiki rooftop. He also produces under the alias SoundSex.
notable_collaborations: Regularly performs alongside fellow Centered Hawaii DJs Jon Conscious and Giuli G

bio: Niall Augustine (also credited as Brendan Augustine) is an emerging producer on the Desert Hearts Black label, best known for his October 2024 debut EP "Seeker," a breaks/UK bass release. He has multiple releases on Desert Hearts Black as well as Red Paradise Record.
labels: Desert Hearts Black; Red Paradise Record

bio: Wronski (Elliot Wronski) is a British-born DJ/producer based in Ibiza, holding residencies at Blue Marlin Ibiza and Sa Trinxa. He plays Balearic-inflected organic house with Afro house and Amapiano influences, and is one half of the duo Playa Moon alongside collaborator ninepoints.

Joanna Magik is a Canadian house DJ/producer and former professional snowboarder and Olympic sports announcer who now serves as resident DJ for the NHL's Calgary Flames. She was named a "Future of Dance" artist by 1001Tracklists and won the Pete Tong x Apple Music mix contest; her discography includes club reworks of tracks by Everything But The Girl and Nelly Furtado.
burning_man_history: Her own website lists Burning Man among past performances, alongside Dirtybird CampINN & CampOUT, Shambhala, and Amsterdam Dance Event (no specific year given).

bio: Franccesco Cardenas, born 1982, grew up in Miami with Nicaraguan roots and began mixing in 2000; he studied audio engineering at SAE in 2004. Now based in the Bay Area (Oakland, CA), he has 20+ years in the industry with 23+ releases and co-founded Typ3 Records in 2012 with Luke Hunter and Alexander Zinn, a label spanning Miami, Oakland and Berlin. His work spans minimal, techno, progressive and downtempo, including remixes of Erik Satie, Max Richter, and The Naked and Famous.
notable_releases: NO WARS, SEE THE STRINGS, #ATR2017, ROBOT BLUES (albums); Approximate Volumes (track)
notable_collaborations: Co-founded Typ3 Records with Luke Hunter and Alexander Zinn; remixed works by Erik Satie, Max Richter, The Naked and Famous, and ZEBLAZED

bio: Josh Forster is a tech house/progressive house DJ who has documented playing Burning Man, with recorded sets released as "Josh Forster @ Disco Lips - Burning Man 2024" and "Josh Forster @ Opulent Chill - Burning Man 2024" on his own SoundCloud.
burning_man_history: Played Disco Lips camp and Opulent Chill camp at Burning Man 2024 (per his own SoundCloud set uploads titled with those camp names and the year).

bio: Museus is a DJ/producer and visual artist from Akron, Ohio with 15+ years of experience, known for disco, funk, playa tech, tech house, deep house and downtempo/chillout sets. He has provided direct support for artists including CloZee, Human Experience, Phutureprimitive, Gaudi, Random Rab, Haana, Ra So, and Ema Stockholma, and has played beach venues in Tulum, Mexico five times and Universo Paralello in Brazil twice.
notable_collaborations: Direct support for CloZee, Human Experience, Phutureprimitive, Gaudi, Random Rab, Haana, Ra So, and Ema Stockholma
burning_man_history: His own website states he has appeared at Burning Man in Nevada five times.

bio: Mario Lui is a DJ/producer originally from Caracas, Venezuela, now based in San Diego, California, blending deep house, Latin grooves, minimal textures and progressive sounds. He co-founded the AMA Sounds collective within the California electronic music scene.
notable_collaborations: Co-founder of the AMA Sounds collective
burning_man_history: An Electronic Groove artist spotlight states his performance history includes Burning Man, among other major venues and festivals (no specific year or camp given).

bio: Philou Louzolo is an Amsterdam-based DJ/producer with 15 years in the industry, named one of DJ Mag's Artists to Watch in 2023. His sound bridges melodic house/techno, progressive drama and Afro house; he launched the event platforms Symfora (at Lofi) and Philou Louzolo & Friends (at Thuishaven), played a 15-hour marathon set at Thuishaven, and performed/spoke at Amsterdam Dance Event 2025. A documentary titled "African Gold," made by his filmmaker cousin, explores his life and career.

This is a back-to-back pairing of two Israeli-born progressive house DJs. Roy Rosenfeld, born August 1, 1987 in Jerusalem, began production at 15 and released commercially from 2009, recording for Lost & Found and Systematic Recordings and remixing artists such as Chris Lake, Tomcraft, and Tube & Berger. Vanjee grew up in Israel immersed in Middle Eastern ballads, disco and rock records, began DJing locally at 12, then moved to New York at 21 to build an international career playing venues like Pacha NY, Club Space and Cipriani; his own biography states he is part of the lineup at Black Coffee Saturdays (Hi Ibiza), BPM Festival, and the Burning Man Festival.
notable_releases: Otro (Lost & Found, 2020), Tikkva (Systematic Recordings, 2017), Skunk Dance (2012) — Roy Rosenfeld
notable_collaborations: Rosenfeld has remixed Chris Lake, John Acquaviva, Lutzenkirchen, Miles Dyson, Lazy Rich, Tomcraft, Milton Jackson, and Tube & Berger, and worked with Guy J and Eli Nissan
burning_man_history: Vanjee's own biography (ra.co / djvanjee.com) lists him as part of the Burning Man Festival lineup in the Nevada desert, alongside Black Coffee Saturdays at Hi Ibiza and BPM Festival (no specific year given).

bio: Thiccboi Drewski is a house/tech house producer and DJ based in Brooklyn, New York, active in the local scene and regularly performing at venues like TBA Brooklyn. His music has appeared on labels including Sloth Acid, Elektroshok, S&S Soundhouse, Dad Bod Records, Therefore, and Ham Factory.
notable_releases: Don't Talk to Me (Extended Mix); Bring It Back (Extended Mix)
labels: Sloth Acid; Elektroshok; S&S Soundhouse; Dad Bod Records; Therefore; Ham Factory

bio: Infected Mushroom is an Israeli-bred, Los Angeles-based psytrance duo, Amit "Duvdev" Duvdevani and Erez Eisen, active since the late 1990s. Pioneers of psytrance who have expanded across genres over 25+ years of global touring, they have been ranked among DJ Magazine's world top ten DJs, and released the 25th-anniversary album "IM25" (2022) and "REBORN" (2024), a reimagining of nine tracks from their 1990s catalog.
notable_releases: IM25 (2022); REBORN (2024), featuring "Release Me," "Dancing with Kadafi," and "Disco Mushroom"
